title.narrative: Strategic Sector Cooperation on Urban Development Argentina

description.narrative: The SSC will assist Buenos Aires in finding solutions that will make the city more connected, energy efficient, environmentally friendly, resilient to external shocks and climate change, and have open, accessible and attractive public spaces

The metropolitan area of Buenos Aires is experiencing a rapid growth of population, however, the city has not benefitted sufficiently from the positive effects of urbanization. 18% of the Argentinian population lives in informal-settlements (slums), pollution partly from heavy traffic impacts air quality, and the absence of efficient and safe public transportation hinders mobility. During the inception phase of this project, the Municipality of Copenhagen will identify areas of common interest in close dialogue with their Argentinian counterpart (The Municipality of Buenos Aires) leading to the formulation of a 3-year peer-to-peer collaboration aimed at enhancing resilience to climate change in Buenos Aires.
